text:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up 1 BrightCare asked for eval-triggered alerts + an Optimize advisor that emits batching/caching/quant recs. they want a short pilot in July.
Samir Khan: sounds like two scoped tracks: alerts (eval hooks + rules + webhook) and advisor (telemetry + heuristics + tiny UI). do we have runway?
Jen Lee: agree split. ship alerts MVP first (simple threshold + per-tenant toggle + webhook) to reduce blast radius.
Ravi Kumar: engineering constraints: alerts need per-prompt eval hooks and a rules engine with windowing; advisor needs aggregated telemetry (p99, tokens, duplicates) and a scoring rule.
Alex Gomez: field ask from BrightCare: low false positives (<5%), clear "why" in recs, and CSV export for audits. they can provide a 2k labeled set.
Maya Patel: proposed gates: (A) alerts validated on a 5k/2k set with FP <=5%, webhook retry/backoff, and ops runbook. (B) advisor: produce 3 ranked recs (batch size, kv-ttl, quant profile) with simulated >=10% cost savings on most workloads.
Ravi Kumar: quick heuristic pseudocode: `if duplicate_rate > 0.25 and p99_latency < 150ms: recommend_kv_ttl = min(600, dup_window) else: recommend_kv_ttl = 0` Quant gating: 100-shot eval; if quality_drop <0.8% and latency_gain >15% recommend int8.
Samir Khan: rough effort: alerts infra + QA ~3 sprints (MVP); advisor backend + heuristics + UI ~3 sprints. shared pieces: telemetry pipeline + flags.
Jen Lee: UX note: alert payload should include metric deltas, sample prompts, and recommended next step (explicit numbers). include copy templates for customers.
Maya Patel: action items: Samir -> acceptance matrix Wed EOD; Ravi -> heuristics sketch Tue; Jen -> alert payload + UX Fri. I'll ask for GPUs for quant sims.
ProductBot: :robot_face: pilot created "BrightCare Optimize Pilot" assigned to maya.patel, samir.khan; target start 2026-07-01.
Maya Patel: follow-ups: confirm labeled set timeline with BrightCare and schedule a 20m kickoff next week.
